c74object.name: evi_smooth_bank
c74object.digest: A GenExpr file, part of 'evieve', for using via 'require()'
c74object.description:
evi_smooth_bank.genexpr is a .genexpr file and is part of the 'evieve' Package.
It is for using in a gen.codebox~ or in another .genexpr file via the require() command.
By declaring require("evi_smooth_bank.genexpr"); at the top of a codebox you can then access all of the functions included in this file.
About this File:
This file contains a subset extracted from the 'evi_smooth.genexpr' file but with no dependencies, for when you need basic smoothing banks and do not wish to require more than is needed. This can be useful in complex require situations and is used by some of the evieve examples.

entry.name: expsmooth ( )
entry.description:
Excellent cheap generic smoother, fast(er) response than 'logsmooth()'
In 1: type=input: x, Value to smooth
In 2: type=input: t, Smoothing time in SECONDS
Return 1: Smooth, Smoothed output ramp
